{{Otheruses|Corellian}}
[[File:Corellian_brandy.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] drinking a Corellian brandy.]]
{{Quote|Once we're clear, we'll have some Corellian brandy I've been saving -- you and I.|[[Gar Stazi]], to [[Nict]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>}}
'''Corellian brandy''' was an expensive [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. This flavorful and savory brandy had to be made with real Corellian fruits.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Corellian Brandy}}</ref> A more expensive variation was [[Corellian Reserve/Legends|Corellian Reserve]].

C. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], a shipment of Corellian brandy intended for [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] was intercepted by corrupt custom officers working for [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]]. [[Miss Mylla]] and some friends of hers discovered a smuggling ring to be behind the operation.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

Both [[Dunari]] and [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends]] enjoyed the beverage. During a conversation with [[Ace Azzameen/Legends]] in [[3 ABY/Legends]], Dunari commented that had Tomaas lived, they’d both be growing “old and happy sipping on Corellian Brandy”.
